🔭 Let’s salute our scientists at ISRO and all those who continue to push the boundaries of discovery, innovation, and exploration.
Speaking at the National Space Day event, Modi ji declared that India is rapidly advancing in breakthrough technologies such as semi-cryogenic engines and electric propulsion. Soon, thanks to the tireless efforts of Indian scientists, India will launch the Gaganyaan mission and, in the coming years, India will also establish its own space station.
